Optional parameters: minbucket: smallest # observations allowed in terminal node. Small terminal nodes likely to be biased by single outlier. minsplit: smallest # observations in the parent node that can be further split. Default=20. maxdepth: prevents tree from growing past certain depth/height. Default=30. cp: complexity pararmeter: minimum improvement in the model needed at each node. Based on the cost complexity of the model (measures mis-classification rate of potential branches). Small cp will allow for more complex models. changing cp from default to 0.001 does not change tree* Cross Validation split training set in 2+ parttitions & creating model for each partition.
